mn21:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
mn21:2.1: tena kho pana samayena āyasmā moliyaphagguno bhikkhunīhi saddhiṃ ativelaṃ saṃsaṭṭho viharati.
mn21:2.2: evaṃ saṃsaṭṭho āyasmā moliyaphagguno bhikkhunīhi saddhiṃ viharati.
mn21:2.3: sace ko ci bhikkhu āyasmato moliyaphaggunassa sammukhā tāsaṃ bhikkhunīnaṃ avaṇṇaṃ bhāsati, tenāyasmā moliyaphagguno kupito anattamano adhikaraṇampi karoti.
mn21:2.4: sace pana ko ci bhikkhu tāsaṃ bhikkhunīnaṃ sammukhā āyasmato moliyaphaggunassa avaṇṇaṃ bhāsati. tena tā bhikkhuniyo kupitā anattamanā adhikaraṇampi karonti.
mn21:2.5: evaṃ saṃsaṭṭho āyasmā moliyaphagguno bhikkhunīhi saddhiṃ viharati.
mn21:3.1: atha kho aññataro bhikkhu yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinno kho so bhikkhu bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
mn21:3.2: “āyasmā bhante moliyaphagguno bhikkhunīhi saddhiṃ ativelaṃ saṃsaṭṭho viharati.
mn21:3.3: evaṃ saṃsaṭṭho bhante āyasmā moliyaphagguno bhikkhunīhi saddhiṃ viharati:
mn21:3.4: sace ko ci bhikkhu āyasmato moliyaphaggunassa sammukhā tāsaṃ bhikkhunīnaṃ avaṇṇaṃ bhāsati, tenāyasmā moliyaphagguno kupito anattamano adhikaraṇampi karoti.
mn21:3.5: sace pana ko ci bhikkhu tāsaṃ bhikkhunīnaṃ sammukhā āyasmato moliyaphaggunassa avaṇṇaṃ bhāsati, tena tā bhikkhuniyo kupitā anattamanā adhikaraṇampi karonti.
mn21:3.6: evaṃ saṃsaṭṭho bhante āyasmā moliyaphagguno bhikkhunīhi saddhiṃ viharatī”ti.
mn21:4.1: atha kho bhagavā aññataraṃ bhikkhuṃ āmantesi:
mn21:4.2: ehi tvaṃ bhikkhu mama vacanena moliyaphaggunaṃ bhikkhuṃ āmantehi:
mn21:4.4: ‘evambhante’ti kho so bhikkhu bhagavato paṭissutvā yenāyasmā moliyaphagguno tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ moliyaphaggunaṃ etadavoca:
mn21:4.6: evamāvusoti kho āyasmā moliyaphagguno tassa bhikkhuno paṭissutvā yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho āyasmantaṃ moliyaphaggunaṃ bhagavā etadavoca:
mn21:5.1: saccaṃ kira tvaṃ phagguna bhikkhunīhi saddhiṃ ativelaṃ saṃsaṭṭho viharasi?
mn21:5.2: evaṃ saṃsaṭṭho kira tvaṃ phagguna bhikkhunīhi saddhiṃ viharasi:
mn21:5.3: “sace ko ci bhikkhu tuyhaṃ sammukhā tāsaṃ bhikkhunīnaṃ avaṇṇaṃ bhāsati, tena tvaṃ kupito anattamano adhikaraṇampi karosi.
mn21:5.4: sace pana ko ci bhikkhu tāsaṃ bhikkhunīnaṃ sammukhā tuyhaṃ avaṇṇaṃ bhāsati, tena tā bhikkhuniyo kupitā anattamanā adhikaraṇampi karonti.
mn21:5.5: evaṃ saṃsaṭṭho kira tvaṃ phagguna bhikkhunīhi saddhiṃ viharasī”ti.
mn21:5.7: nanu tvaṃ phagguna kulaputto saddhā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajitoti?
mn21:6.1: na kho te etaṃ phagguna patirūpaṃ, kulaputtassa saddhā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajitassa, yaṃ tvaṃ bhikkhunīhi saddhiṃ ativelaṃ saṃsaṭṭho vihareyyāsi.
mn21:6.2: tasmātiha phagguna tava cepi ko ci sammukhā tāsaṃ bhikkhunīnaṃ avaṇṇaṃ bhāseyya, tatrāpi tvaṃ phagguna ye gehasitā chandā ye gehasitā vitakkā te pajaheyyāsi.
mn21:6.4: “na ceva me cittaṃ vipariṇataṃ bhavissati, na ca pāpikaṃ vācaṃ nicchāressāmi, hitānukampī ca viharissāmi mettacitto na dosantaro”ti.
mn21:6.6: tasmātiha phagguna tava cepi ko ci sammukhā tāsaṃ bhikkhunīnaṃ pāṇinā pahāraṃ dadeyya, leḍḍunā pahāraṃ dadeyya, daṇḍena pahāraṃ dadeyya, satthena pahāraṃ dadeyya. tatrāpi tvaṃ phagguna ye gehasitā chandā ye gehasitā vitakkā te pajaheyyāsi.
mn21:6.8: na ceva me cittaṃ vipariṇataṃ bhavissati na ca pāpikaṃ vācaṃ nicchāressāmi. hitānukampī ca viharissāmi mettacitto na dosantaroti.
mn21:6.10: tasmātiha phagguna tava cepi ko ci sammukhā avaṇṇaṃ bhāseyya, tatrāpi tvaṃ phagguna ye gehasitā chandā ye gehasitā vitakkā te pajaheyyāsi.
mn21:6.11: tatrāpi te phagguna evaṃ sikkhitabbaṃ: na ceva me cittaṃ vipariṇataṃ bhavissati na ca pāpikaṃ vācaṃ nicchāressāmi hitānukampī ca viharissāmi mettacitto na dosantaroti,
mn21:6.13: tasmātiha phagguna tava cepi ko ci pāṇinā pahāraṃ dadeyya, leḍḍunā pahāraṃ dadeyya, daṇḍena pahāraṃ dadeyya, satthena pahāraṃ dadeyya. tatrāpi tvaṃ phagguna ye gehasitā chandā ye gehasitā vitakkā te pajaheyyāsi.
mn21:6.14: tatrāpi te phagguna evaṃ sikkhitabbaṃ: na ceva me cittaṃ vipariṇataṃ bhavissati na ca pāpikaṃ vācaṃ nicchāressāmi. hitānukampī ca viharissāmi mettacitto na dosantaroti.
mn21:7.2: ārādhayiṃsu vata me bhikkhave bhikkhū ekaṃ samayaṃ cittaṃ.
mn21:7.5: ekāsanabhojanaṃ kho ahaṃ bhikkhave bhuñjamāno appābādhatañca sañjānāmi appātaṅkatañca lahuṭṭhānañca balañca phāsuvihārañca.
mn21:7.7: ekāsanabhojanaṃ kho bhikkhave tumhepi bhuñjamānā appābādhatañca sañjānissatha appātaṅkatañca lahuṭṭhānañca balañca phāsuvihārañcā’ti.
mn21:7.8: na me bhikkhave tesu bhikkhūsu anusāsanī karaṇīyā ahosi.
mn21:7.9: satuppādakaraṇīyameva me bhikkhave tesu bhikkhusu ahosi.
mn21:7.10: seyyathāpi bhikkhave subhūmiyaṃ cātummahāpathe ājaññaratho yutto assa ṭhito odhastapatodo,
mn21:7.11: tamenaṃ dakkho yoggācariyo assadammasārathi abhirūhitvā vāmena hatthena rasmiyo gahetvā dakkhiṇena hatthena patodaṃ gahetvā yenicchakaṃ yadicchakaṃ sāreyyāpi paccāsāreyyāpi,
mn21:7.12: evameva kho bhikkhave na me tesu bhikkhūsu anusāsanī karaṇīyā ahosi.
mn21:7.13: satuppādakaraṇīyameva me bhikkhave tesu bhikkhusu ahosi.
mn21:7.14: tasmātiha bhikkhave tumhepi akusalaṃ pajahatha. kusalesu dhammesu āyogaṃ karotha.
mn21:7.15: evaṃ hi tumhepi imasmiṃ dhammavinaye vuddhiṃ virūḷhiṃ vepullaṃ āpajjissatha.
mn21:8.1: seyyathāpi bhikkhave gāmassa vā nigamassa vā avidūre mahantaṃ sālavanaṃ,
mn21:8.3: tassa kocideva puriso uppajjeyya atthakāmo hitakāmo yogakkhemakāmo.
mn21:8.4: so yā tā sālalaṭṭhiyo kuṭilā ojāpaharaṇīyo tā tacchetvā bahiddhā nīhareyya, antovanaṃ suvisodhitaṃ visodheyya.
mn21:8.5: yā pana tā sālalaṭṭhiyo ujukā sujātā tā sammā parihareyya,
mn21:8.6: evaṃ hetaṃ bhikkhave sālavanaṃ aparena samayena vuddhiṃ virūḷhiṃ vepullaṃ āpajjeyya.
mn21:8.7: evameva kho bhikkhave tumhepi akusalaṃ pajahatha. kusalesu dhammesu āyogaṃ karotha.
mn21:8.8: evaṃ hi tumhepi imasmiṃ dhammavinaye vuddhiṃ virūḷhiṃ vepullaṃ āpajjissatha.
mn21:9.1: bhūtapubbaṃ bhikkhave imissāyeva sāvatthiyā vedehikā nāma gahapatānī ahosi.
mn21:9.2: vedehikāya bhikkhave gahapatāniyā evaṃ kalyāṇo kittisaddo abbhuggato:
mn21:9.3: soratā vedehikā gahapatānī, nivātā vedehikā gahapatānī, upasantā vedehikā gahapatānīti.
mn21:9.4: vedehikāya kho pana bhikkhave gahapatāniyā kāḷī nāma dāsī ahosi, dakkhā analasā susaṃvihitakammantā.
mn21:9.5: atha kho bhikkhave kāḷiyā dāsiyā etadahosi:
mn21:9.6: mayhaṃ kho ayyāya evaṃ kalyāṇo kittisaddo abbhuggato:
mn21:9.7: soratā vedehikā gahapatānī, nivātā vedehikā gahapatānī, upasantā vedehikā gahapatānīti.
mn21:9.8: kinnu kho me ayyā santaṃyeva nu kho ajjhattaṃ kopaṃ na pātukaroti? udāhu asantaṃ?
mn21:9.9: udāhu mayhevete kammantā susaṃvihitā, yena me ayyā santaṃyeva ajjhattaṃ kopaṃ na pātukaroti? no asantaṃ?
mn21:9.11: atha kho bhikkhave kāḷī dāsī divā uṭṭhāsi.
mn21:9.12: atha kho bhikkhave vedehikā gahapatānī kāḷiṃ dāsiṃ etadavoca:
mn21:9.17: no vata re kiñci pāpī dāsī divā uṭṭhāsī’ti kupitā anattamanā bhākuṭiṃ akāsi.
mn21:9.18: atha kho bhikkhave kāḷiyā dāsiyā etadahosi:
mn21:9.19: santaṃyeva kho me ayyā ajjhattaṃ kopaṃ na pātukaroti no asantaṃ.
mn21:9.20: mayhevete kammantā susaṃvihitā, yena me ayyā santaṃyeva ajjhattaṃ kopaṃ na pātukaroti no asantaṃ.
mn21:9.22: atha kho bhikkhave kāḷīdāsī divātaraṃ uṭṭhāsi.
mn21:9.23: atha kho bhikkhave vedehikā gahapatānī kāḷiṃ dāsiṃ etadavoca:
mn21:9.28: no vata re kiñci pāpī dāsi, divātaraṃ uṭṭhāsīti kupitā anattamanā anattamanavācaṃ nicchāresi.
mn21:9.29: atha kho bhikkhave kāḷiyā dāsiyā etadahosi:
mn21:9.30: santaṃyeva kho me ayyā ajjhattaṃ kopaṃ na pātukaroti no asantaṃ,
mn21:9.31: mayhevete kammantā susaṃvihitā yena me ayyā santaṃyeva ajjhattaṃ kopaṃ na pātukaroti no asantaṃ;
mn21:9.33: atha kho bhikkhave kāḷī dāsī divātaraṃyeva uṭṭhāsi.
mn21:9.34: atha kho bhikkhave vedehikā gahapatānī kāḷiṃ dāsiṃ etadavoca:
mn21:9.39: no vata re kiñci pāpī dāsi, divā uṭṭhāsīti kupitā anattamanā aggaḷasūciṃ gahetvā sīse pahāraṃ adāsi. sīsaṃ vobhindi.
mn21:9.40: atha kho bhikkhave kāḷī dāsī bhinnena sīsena lohitena gaḷantena paṭivissakānaṃ ujjhāpesi:
mn21:9.42: passathayyā, nivātāya kammaṃ. passathayyā, upasantāya kammaṃ
mn21:9.43: kathaṃ hi nāma ekadāsikāya ‘divā uṭṭhāsī’ti kupitā anattamanā aggaḷasūciṃ gahetvā sīse pahāraṃ dassati, sīsaṃ vobhindissatīti?
mn21:9.44: atha kho bhikkhave vedehikāya gahapatāniyā aparena samayena evaṃ pāpako kittisaddo abbhuggañchi:
mn21:9.45: caṇḍī vedehikā gahapatānī, anivātā vedehikā gahapatānī, anupasantā vedehikā gahapatānīti.
mn21:10.1: evameva kho bhikkhave idhekacco bhikkhu tāvadeva soratasorato hoti nivātanivāto hoti upasantupasanto hoti yāva na naṃ amanāpā vacanapathā phusanti.
mn21:10.2: yato ca kho bhikkhave bhikkhuṃ amanāpā vacanapathā phusanti, atha bhikkhu soratoti veditabbo nivātoti veditabbo. upasantoti veditabbo.
mn21:10.3: nāhaṃ taṃ bhikkhave bhikkhuṃ suvacoti vadāmi, yo cīvarapiṇḍapātasenāsanagilānapaccayabhesajjaparikkhārahetu suvaco hoti. sovacassataṃ āpajjati.
mn21:10.5: taṃ hi so bhikkhave bhikkhu cīvarapiṇḍapātasenāsanagilānapaccayabhesajjaparikkhāraṃ alabhamāno na suvaco hoti. na sovacassataṃ āpajjati.
mn21:10.6: yo ca kho bhikkhave bhikkhu dhammaṃyeva sakkaronto dhammaṃ garukaronto dhammaṃ apacāyamāno suvaco hoti sovacassataṃ āpajjati, tamahaṃ suvacoti vadāmi.
mn21:10.7: tasmātiha bhikkhave evaṃ sikkhitabbaṃ: dhammaṃyeva sakkarontā dhammaṃ garukarontā dhammaṃ apacāyamānā suvacā bhavissāma, sovacassataṃ āpajjissāmāti.
mn21:11.1: pañcime bhikkhave vacanapathā yehi vo pare vadamānā vadeyyuṃ:
mn21:11.7: kālena vā bhikkhave pare vadamānā vadeyyuṃ akālena vā.
mn21:11.8: bhūtena vā bhikkhave pare vadamānā vadeyyuṃ abhūtena vā.
mn21:11.9: saṇhena vā bhikkhave pare vadamānā vadeyyuṃ pharusena vā.
mn21:11.10: atthasaṃhitena vā bhikkhave pare vadamānā, vadeyyuṃ anatthasaṃhitena vā;
mn21:11.11: mettacittā vā bhikkhave pare vadamānā, vadeyyuṃ dosantarā vā.
mn21:11.13: na ceva no cittaṃ vipariṇataṃ bhavissati. na ca pāpikaṃ vācaṃ nicchāressāma. hitānukampī ca viharissāma mettacittā na dosantarā.
mn21:11.14: tañca puggalaṃ mettāsahagatena cetasā pharitvā viharissāma. tadārammaṇañca sabbāvantaṃ lokaṃ mettāsahagatena cetasā vipulena mahaggatena appamāṇena averena abyāpajjhena pharitvā viharissāmāti.
mn21:12.1: seyyathāpi bhikkhave puriso āgaccheyya kuddālapiṭakaṃ ādāya,
mn21:12.4: so tatra tatra khaṇeyya, tatra tatra vikireyya, tatra tatra oṭṭhubheyya, tatra tatra omutteyya:
mn21:12.7: api nu so puriso imaṃ mahāpaṭhaviṃ apaṭhaviṃ kareyyāti?
mn21:12.10: ayaṃ hi bhante mahāpaṭhavī gambhīrā appameyyā.
mn21:12.12: yāvadeva ca pana so puriso kilamathassa vighātassa bhāgī assā’ti.
mn21:13.1: evameva kho bhikkhave pañcime vacanapathā, yehi vo pare vadamānā vadeyyuṃ:
mn21:13.7: kālena vā bhikkhave pare vadamānā vadeyyuṃ akālena vā
mn21:13.8: bhūtena vā bhikkhave pare vadamānā vadeyyuṃ abhūtena vā.
mn21:13.9: saṇhena vā bhikkhave pare vadamānā vadeyyuṃ pharusena vā.
mn21:13.10: atthasaṃhitena vā bhikkhave pare vadamānā vadeyyuṃ anatthasaṃhitena vā.
mn21:13.11: mettacittā vā bhikkhave pare vadamānā vadeyyuṃ dosantarā vā.
mn21:13.13: na ceva no cittaṃ vipariṇataṃ bhavissati. na ca pāpikaṃ vācaṃ nicchāressāma. hitānukampī ca viharissāma mettacittā na dosantarā.
mn21:13.14: tañca puggalaṃ mettāsahagatena cetasā pharitvā viharissāma– tadārammaṇañca sabbāvantaṃ lokaṃ paṭhavisamena cetasā vipulena mahaggatena appamāṇena averena abyāpajjhena pharitvā viharissāmāti.
mn21:14.1: seyyathāpi bhikkhave puriso āgaccheyya lākhaṃ vā haliddiṃ vā nīlaṃ vā mañjiṭṭhaṃ vā ādāya.
mn21:14.3: ahaṃ imasmiṃ ākāse rūpāni likhissāmi, rūpapātubhāvaṃ karissāmīti.
mn21:14.5: api nu so puriso imasmiṃ ākāse rūpaṃ likheyya rūpapātubhāvaṃ kareyyāti?
mn21:14.9: tattha na sukaraṃ rūpaṃ likhituṃ rūpapātubhāvaṃ kātuṃ.
mn21:14.10: yāvadeva ca pana so puriso kilamathassa vighātassa bhāgī assā’ti.
mn21:15.1: evameva kho bhikkhave pañcime vacanapathā yehi vo pare vadamānā vadeyyuṃ: kālena vā akālena vā …pe…
mn21:15.2: tadārammaṇañca sabbāvantaṃ lokaṃ ākāsasamena cetasā vipulena mahaggatena appamāṇena averena abyāpajjhena pharitvā viharissāmā’ti.
mn21:16.1: seyyathāpi bhikkhave puriso āgaccheyya ādittaṃ tiṇukkaṃ ādāya.
mn21:16.3: ahaṃ imāya ādittāya tiṇukkāya gaṅgaṃ nadiṃ santāpessāmi samparitāpessāmīti.
mn21:16.5: api nu so puriso ādittāya tiṇukkāya gaṅgaṃ nadiṃ santāpeyya samparitāpeyyāti?
mn21:16.9: sā na sukarā ādittāya tiṇukkāya santāpetuṃ samparitāpetuṃ.
mn21:16.10: yāvadeva ca pana so puriso kilamathassa vighātassa bhāgī assā’ti.
mn21:17.1: evameva kho bhikkhave pañcime vacanapathā, yehi vo pare vadamānā vadeyyuṃ kālena vā akālena …pe…
mn21:17.2: tadārammaṇañca sabbāvantaṃ lokaṃ gaṅgāsamena cetasā vipulena mahaggatena appamāṇena averena abyāpajjhena pharitvā viharissāmāti.
mn21:18.1: seyyathāpi bhikkhave biḷārabhastā madditā sumadditā suparimadditā mudukā tulinī chinnasassarā chinnabhabbharā,
mn21:18.2: atha puriso āgaccheyya kaṭṭhaṃ vā kaṭhalaṃ vā ādāya,
mn21:18.4: ahaṃ imaṃ biḷārabhastaṃ madditaṃ sumadditaṃ suparimadditaṃ mudukaṃ tuliniṃ chinnasassaraṃ chinnababbharaṃ kaṭṭhena vā kaṭhalena vā sarasaraṃ karissāmi bharabharaṃ karissāmīti.
mn21:18.6: api nu so puriso amuṃ biḷārabhastaṃ madditaṃ sumadditaṃ suparimadditaṃ mudukaṃ tuliniṃ chinnasassaraṃ chinnabhabbharaṃ kaṭṭhena vā kaṭhalena vā sarasaraṃ kareyya bharabharaṃ kareyyāti?
mn21:18.9: ‘asu hi bhante, biḷārabhastā madditā sumadditā suparimadditā mudukā tulinī chinnasassarā chinnabhabbharā,
mn21:18.10: sā na sukarā kaṭṭhena vā kaṭhalena vā sarasaraṃ kātuṃ bharabharaṃ kātuṃ.
mn21:18.11: yāvadeva ca pana so puriso kilamathassa vighātassa bhāgī assā’ti.
mn21:19.1: evameva kho bhikkhave pañcime vacanapathā yehi vo pare vadamānā vadeyyuṃ:
mn21:19.7: kālena vā bhikkhave pare vadamānā vadeyyuṃ akālena vā.
mn21:19.8: bhūtena vā bhikkhave pare vadamānā vadeyyuṃ abhūtena vā.
mn21:19.9: saṇhena vā bhikkhave pare vadamānā vadeyyuṃ pharusena vā.
mn21:19.10: atthasaṃhitena vā bhikkhave pare vadamānā vadeyyuṃ anatthasaṃhitena vā.
mn21:19.11: mettacittā vā bhikkhave pare vadamānā vadeyyuṃ dosantarā vā.
mn21:19.13: “na ceva no cittaṃ vipariṇataṃ bhavissati. na ca pāpikaṃ vācaṃ nicchāressāma. hitānukampī ca viharissāma mettacittā na dosantarā.
mn21:19.14: tañca puggalaṃ mettāsahagatena cetasā pharitvā viharissāma. tadārammaṇañca sabbāvantaṃ lokaṃ biḷārabhastāsamena cetasā vipulena mahaggatena appamāṇena averena abyāpajjhena pharitvā viharissāmā”ti.
mn21:20.1: ubhatodaṇḍakena pi ce bhikkhave kakacena corā ocarakā aṅgamaṅgāni okanteyyuṃ, tatrāpi yo mano padūseyya, na me so tena sāsanakaro.
mn21:20.3: “na ceva no cittaṃ vipariṇataṃ bhavissati. na ca pāpikaṃ vācaṃ nicchāressāma. hitānukampī ca viharissāma mettacittā na dosantarā.
mn21:20.4: tañca puggalaṃ mettāsahagatena cetasā pharitvā viharissāma. tadārammaṇañca sabbāvantaṃ lokaṃ mettāsahagatena cetasā vipulena mahaggatena appamāṇena averena abyāpajjhena pharitvā viharissāmā”ti.
mn21:21.1: imañca tumhe bhikkhave kakacūpamaṃ ovādaṃ abhikkhaṇaṃ manasikareyyātha.
mn21:21.2: passatha no tumhe bhikkhave taṃ vacanapathaṃ aṇuṃ vā thūlaṃ vā yaṃ tumhe nādhivāseyyāthāti?
mn21:21.4: tasmātiha bhikkhave imaṃ kakacūpamaṃ ovādaṃ abhikkhaṇaṃ manasi karotha.
mn21:21.5: taṃ vo bhavissati dīgharattaṃ hitāya sukhāyāti.
mn21:21.7: attamanā te bhikkhū bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinandunti.
